title: Anna and the City Map
text:
Anna goes to the train station every morning. She looks at the timetable on the wall. The train to the city leaves at 7:30. Anna likes to check the map before she walks to the platform.

Today Anna needs a new map of the city. The map shows the bus lines and the metro stations. Anna finds a small shop near the station and buys one. Now she knows where to go.

questions.text: Where does Anna go every morning?
What does the new map show?
options: The bus lines and the metro stations

questions.text: Why does Anna check the map before she walks to the platform?
options: She wants to be sure she goes the right way
She wants to take a photo
She is looking for the shop

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna?
options: She uses public transport in the city
She drives a car to work
She lives far away from the city

vocabulary.definition: a list that shows when trains or buses leave and arrive
the raised area at a station where people wait for a train
an underground railway system in a city
a small place where you buy things

paragraph_translations: Anna chodzi na dworzec kolejowy każdego ranka. Patrzy na rozkład jazdy na ścianie. Pociąg do miasta odjeżdża o 7:30. Anna lubi sprawdzać mapę, zanim pójdzie na peron.
Dzisiaj Anna potrzebuje nowej mapy miasta. Mapa pokazuje linie autobusowe i stacje metra. Anna znajduje mały sklep przy dworcu i kupuje jedną. Teraz wie, dokąd iść.
